en.title: Dvořák: String Quartet No. 12, Op. 96 – II. Lento: A Listening Guide
en.overview: This is a slow movement in 6/8 time with 97 measures. It has two parts: a long Part 1 (measures 1-81) and a short closing section marked "a tempo" (measures 82-97). The home key is D minor. Keys and chords in this guide are estimated by computer, so they may contain small errors. Listen for the opening tune, the way the key keeps shifting, and the quiet return of the tune in the cello at the end.

listening_points.headline: A soft, shared opening
listening_points.text: The movement begins softly in D minor. Three parts play [m. 1-2]. The analysis finds no clear leader here, so the lead is shared.

listening_points.headline: The main theme enters in the first violin
listening_points.text: Violin 1 plays the main theme at [m. 3-4]. The others accompany it at [m. 3]. Remember this tune, because it comes back later in the cello.

listening_points.headline: A loud moment in the first violin
listening_points.text: At [m. 7-8] the music is loud (f). At [m. 9] it drops to mf. Violin 1 keeps the lead. The key stays D minor.

listening_points.headline: The cello takes the theme, very softly
listening_points.text: The cello plays the main theme at [m. 11-12]. It is the same tune, one octave lower. The music is now very soft (pp), in D minor.

listening_points.headline: A brighter touch: C major
listening_points.text: The music moves to C major at [m. 17-19]. C major is a brighter key than D minor. The dynamics go from mf to p and then pp.

listening_points.headline: Darker colours and a loud peak
listening_points.text: The key moves to G minor at [m. 20-22]. It then goes back to D minor at [m. 23-26]. The music is loud (f) at [m. 22]. The lines move independently there.

listening_points.headline: A long stay in F major
listening_points.text: The music settles in F major at [m. 27-31]. It visits G minor at [m. 32-33]. It returns to F major at [m. 34-41]. Much of this stretch has independent lines, so the tune is shared. The music is very soft (pp) by [m. 41].

listening_points.headline: A new mood in A minor
listening_points.text: At [m. 42-45] the key changes to A minor. Violin 1 leads over an accompaniment. The music starts very soft and then reaches mp.

listening_points.headline: G minor, then a hushed D minor
listening_points.text: The music goes to G minor at [m. 46-51]. It then moves to D minor at [m. 52-53] at very soft level (pp). Violin 1 probably leads most of this stretch.

listening_points.headline: A burst of ff, then a calm C major
listening_points.text: At [m. 54] the key is A minor. After a marking to grow louder, the music reaches very loud (ff) at [m. 55]. Soon after, it moves to C major at [m. 57-61]. The level falls to pp by [m. 60].

listening_points.headline: A build to the loudest point
listening_points.text: A minor returns at [m. 62-64]. The music then moves to G minor. The analysis marks [m. 66] as the loudest and busiest point (ff). This is a computer estimate. Violin 1 leads there.

listening_points.headline: Quiet again, then heading home
listening_points.text: The music drops suddenly to p at [m. 67] and then to pp at [m. 68]. D minor returns at [m. 72-75]. The music is loud (f) at [m. 74].

listening_points.headline: F major glow, then fading
listening_points.text: The key brightens to F major at [m. 76-80]. There is a marking to fade at [m. 76], and the music ends up at pp by [m. 80]. D minor comes back at [m. 81].

listening_points.headline: The cello brings back the main theme
listening_points.text: The final section is marked "a tempo". The cello plays the main theme at [m. 82-83] and again at [m. 86-87]. Both times it is in D minor, an octave lower than the opening. It is soft (p, then pp), and the others accompany.

listening_points.headline: One last flare, then near silence
listening_points.text: After a marking to grow louder, the music is loud (f) at [m. 88]. The music then falls back to pp. It reaches ppp at [m. 94]. The viola leads at [m. 95-96]. The last bar, [m. 97], has the parts moving together in D minor.

glossary.explanation: The home note and scale a passage seems to belong to. Minor keys sound darker. Major keys sound brighter.
A move from one key to another.
The principal tune. Here it first appears in Violin 1 near the start.
One part has the tune while the others support it.
Several parts play their own lines at once, so no single tune stands out.
All parts move together in chords.

glossary.term: Dynamics (pp, p, mp, mf, f, ff, ppp)
glossary.explanation: Loudness levels. ppp is the softest and ff is very loud.
An instruction to return to the original speed.

zh.title: 德沃夏克《“美国”弦乐四重奏》第二乐章 Lento 听赏指南
zh.overview: 本乐章为慢板，6/8拍，主调为D小调，共97小节。分析显示它分为两大部分：第1-81小节是第一部分，第82-97小节是“回到原速”（a tempo）的第二部分。请留意各声部谁在领奏、音量的强弱起伏，以及调性的不断转换。最后一段大多由大提琴领奏，结尾音量沉到极弱。调性与和弦均为软件自动估计，可能有误。主奏声部也是估计，低置信度处请当作大致参考。

listening_points.headline: 轻柔的开场，三个声部轻轻铺底
listening_points.text: 乐章以弱（p）开始，D小调。[m. 1-2] 织体被标为三声部（trio），主奏并不明确，最多只能说是第二小提琴和中提琴共同承担。

listening_points.headline: 第一小提琴明确领奏
listening_points.text: 从[m. 3]起第一小提琴奏出主题 [m. 3-4]，其余声部伴奏。这里主奏很明确。随后音量时强时弱，[m. 7-8]达到强（f）。

listening_points.headline: 大提琴转为主奏，音量降到很弱
listening_points.text: [m. 11]音量降到很弱（pp）。大提琴比开头低一个八度奏出主题 [m. 11-12]，这里很可能由大提琴主奏。

listening_points.headline: 转向C大调、G小调，色彩变化
listening_points.text: [m. 17-19] 转入C大调，随后[m. 20-22]到G小调。音量在弱与强之间起伏，[m. 22]为强（f）。这一段主奏不太确定，较像是几个声部共享。

listening_points.headline: 回到D小调，再走向F大调
listening_points.text: [m. 23-26] 短暂回到D小调，[m. 27-31] 进入F大调。大调通常听起来更明亮。这里多为各声部独立行进的线条，第一小提琴大概领奏。

listening_points.headline: G小调与F大调之间摇摆，声音渐轻
listening_points.text: [m. 32-33] 回到G小调，[m. 34-41] 又回到F大调。[m. 35]有强（f）的高点，[m. 40-41]则渐弱到很弱（pp）。这一段声部各自独立，不是单纯的旋律加伴奏。

listening_points.headline: A小调：第一小提琴领奏较明确
listening_points.text: [m. 42-45] 进入A小调，第一小提琴领奏的把握较高。[m. 46-51] 转到G小调，音量在强（f）与很弱（pp）之间变化。

listening_points.headline: D小调、A小调，再到C大调
listening_points.text: [m. 52-53] 回到D小调，很弱（pp）。[m. 54-56] 转入A小调，经过渐强，[m. 55]达到很强（ff）。[m. 57-61] 转入C大调，音量变轻。

listening_points.headline: 电脑估计的最响处：第66小节
listening_points.text: [m. 62-64] 回到A小调，[m. 65-71] 进入G小调。分析标出的最响、最忙处在[m. 66]，为很强（ff）。这是电脑估计的结果。之后音量变弱。

listening_points.headline: 回到D小调，经F大调渐渐安静
listening_points.text: [m. 72-75] 回到D小调，[m. 74]为强（f）。[m. 76-80] 转到F大调，[m. 80]为很弱（pp）。[m. 81] 回到D小调，为第一部分作结。

listening_points.headline: 回到原速，大提琴清晰领奏
listening_points.text: [m. 82] 起进入“回到原速”的第二部分。大提琴领奏，把握很高，两次奏出主题 [m. 82-83, 86-87]，比开头低一个八度。其余声部伴奏。音量为弱（p）到很弱（pp），调性为D小调。

listening_points.headline: 一次强音之后，沉入极弱
listening_points.text: [m. 88] 有一个强（f）的突出点，随后在[m. 89]变弱（p），[m. 90]起为很弱（pp）。[m. 94]降到极弱（ppp）。大提琴仍是主要声部。

listening_points.headline: 中提琴领着，极轻地收尾
listening_points.text: [m. 95-96] 中提琴领奏，保持极弱（ppp）。[m. 97] 织体变为主调织体，即几个声部一起走和弦。乐章在D小调中结束。

glossary.explanation: 音乐的“中心音”改变，色彩随之变亮或变暗。
小调听起来偏暗、忧伤，大调偏明亮。
几个声部节奏基本一致，一起走和弦。
很弱 / 极弱。f 为强，ff 为很强。
乐谱用语，意思是回到原来的速度。
